description: Drive tab, signed in, parked, three past trips. The friends map fills the whole screen under a transparent status bar; friends are round initials pins. Floating at the top: a pill-shaped status capsule on the raised surface with a soft shadow reading 'Ready. Drives start on their own.' in 14 sp semibold next to a small breathing orange dot (tap opens an 'Auto-detect' sheet: Start a drive now, Pause for 1 hour, Pause for 4 hours, Pause until tomorrow, Turn off auto-detect), and two 48 px round tonal buttons: friend requests (envelope icon with a count badge) and your avatar with an orange ring (opens Profile, where Settings lives). Under the capsule, circle filter chips 'All · Carpool · Family' and, when nobody is sharing, a small 'No friends on the map yet · Add friend' pill. From the bottom a sheet with a 28 px radius and a handle peeks at a third of the screen and snaps to peek, half or full: a 12 sp uppercase kicker 'LAST TRIP', then a borderless tile with a 96 px score ring that sweeps in from zero while its number counts up, the date in 13 sp, the verdict in 20 sp semibold ('Smooth from the driveway to the parking lot. Textbook.'), and three small figures with labels: 11.3 mi Distance, 23 min Time, +70 XP. Dragging up reveals 'RECENT' and compact rows (44 px ring, one-line verdict, 'Yesterday, 6:30 PM · 3.5 mi · 13 min'). Rows fade and slide in one after another; every tile scales down on press with a light haptic; long-press a trip for Share / Mark as passenger / Delete; tap flies the ring into the trip screen. No app bar, no outlined cards, 20 px gutters. With no trips the sheet reads 'Go for a drive.' at 28 sp and 'We'll score it when you park.'

Drive tab while a trip is being recorded. The map stays the full-screen stage. The capsule at the top cross-fades into a breathing dot, the live speed '45' at 64 sp tabular with 'mph' at 14 sp beside it and a 'Limit 45' pill that turns red when over; the two round buttons stay. The sheet animates up to show the live block and nothing else: '45' at 64 sp that counts as it changes with 'mph' at 14 sp, 'Recording' with a pulsing dot at the right, 'Limit 45 mph · Harding Pike' in 20 sp semibold ('4 over the limit' in red when speeding), two tiles '8.0 mi Distance' and '14 min Time' whose numbers count, and one full-width 56 px 'End drive' button. The last trip and recents sit below, reachable by dragging the sheet up. When the drive ends the sheet drops back and, once parked, the full-screen 'TRIP SCORED' moment appears over the map: the ring scales and sweeps in, '+XP' counts up, the verdict slides up, confetti above 90 or a stamp below 40, new badges slide in as pills, a medium haptic, 'Share' and 'Nice'. A score that lands mid-drive buzzes once and waits.

Trip detail screen. The route map fills the top 40% and fades under the content as you scroll (or a calm 'ROUTE / Route not saved for this trip.' panel); a transparent app bar over it with 'Today, 5:42 PM', a share icon and an overflow (Mark as passenger, Score again, Delete trip). Content on the plain surface with 20 px gutters, each section fading and sliding in a beat after the last: a 120 px score ring '58' that arrives by Hero from the list and sweeps from zero, '+32 XP' counting up under it, and beside it the italic verdict at 24 sp 'Two phone grabs and 48 in a 35. The roast writes itself.' with one muted 16 sp line. Kicker 'BREAKDOWN': four rows with a 13 sp label (Speed, Smoothness, Attention, Efficiency), a thin bar coloured by how much was kept that animates to its width, and a 14 sp value (−24, Clean). Kicker 'STATS': a 3×2 grid of borderless tiles (9.2 mi Distance, 23 min Driving, 24 mph Average, 48 mph Top speed, 1 min 14 s Over the limit, 11 sec Time saved). Kicker 'WHAT HAPPENED': timeline rows with a 40 px tinted icon circle, one plain line ('48 in a 35 for 1 min 14 s on Harding Pike', 'Phone picked up 2 times, 23 seconds at up to 38 mph', 'Hard brake at 40 mph'), a 13 sp 'Speeding · 5:51 PM', and a flag button on speeding rows that opens a sheet 'Limit is wrong here' with one 'Send' button and a success haptic. A 13 sp footnote '82% of this drive had known limits.' Tiles press-scale; sheets slide up with the emphasized curve.

First launch, no permissions, no trips: three full-screen pages in a PageView with a dot indicator, each element fading in a beat after the last. Page one: a 48 px car icon in the accent colour, kicker 'DRIVALRY', 'Every drive gets a score.' at 28 sp, one muted 16 sp line 'Drives start and stop on their own and are scored on this phone when you park.', one 56 px 'Next' button. Page two: a location icon, kicker 'LOCATION', 'Allow location all the time.', 'Drives then start on their own, even when the app is closed.', one 'Allow' button (fires the OS prompt with a spinner while it runs) and a 'Not now' text button. Page three: a motion icon, kicker 'MOTION', 'Allow motion.', 'Tells the phone you have started moving, so recording begins on time.', an 'Allowed' pill once granted, and one button reading 'Allow', then 'Open settings' after a refusal, or 'Done'. Finishing or skipping lands on the map-first Drive home with a light success haptic; if permissions are still missing the sheet shows a single tile 'Turn on auto-detect · Drives start on their own, even with the app closed.' instead of paragraphs.

Dark page. A large 'Friends' title (28 sp) at the top-left that shrinks into the toolbar as you scroll, with one requests icon (badge count) top-right; Feed / Friends / Circles tabs pinned beneath. A row of stadium filter chips (All selected in primaryContainer, Wall of Fame, Wall of Shame, A friend). Then post cards: borderless rounded tonal tiles, 20 px gutter, 24 px apart, each sliding up and fading in 40 ms after the previous. Card: 40 px avatar (initials; taps to the profile and flies there as a hero), name in 14 sp semibold, '@priya · 2 h ago' in 13 sp muted, and a teal 'WALL OF FAME' / red 'WALL OF SHAME' kicker on the right only when the post is one. Below: a 56 px score ring coloured by score with the number inside, the roast verdict in 16 sp beside it, compact icon pills for points lost (e.g. speed −46). Then one horizontally scrolling row of emoji reaction capsules (yours tinted primary) that scale to 0.9 on press with a selection haptic and whose counts count up; under it '2 comments' with a small icon. Tapping the card springs it (0.97) with a light haptic and opens the post; long-press opens a bottom sheet with a React row, Comment, Share, Report. While loading, three shimmering skeleton tiles; empty: 'FEED' kicker, 'Nothing yet.' headline, 'Add a friend and the roasts start.', one 56 px Add friend button; a failure is a quiet tile with Retry. Pull down to refresh. One extended 'Add friend' FAB bottom-right only when posts exist.

Dark full-bleed page, no app bar. Centred: the Drivalry mark on its 96 px dark rounded tile fading and rising in, 24 px below it 'Drivalry' in 28 sp headline, then one 16 sp line 'Score your drives. Beat your friends. Get roasted.' 32 px below: two full-width 56 px buttons that scale on press: 'Continue with Apple' filled primary with the Apple glyph (iOS only) and 'Continue with Google' tonal with a person icon (Google alone becomes the filled one on Android). Any failure shows one friendly sentence in the error colour under the buttons (never a configuration message; 'Sign-in isn't available in this version yet.' replaces the buttons in a version without sign-in). Bottom: a 'Not now' text button that pops the screen, then the 13 sp muted privacy sentence 'Adding a friend shares your live location with them. You can hide it any time in Settings.' A success gives a medium haptic and returns to where you came from.

Settings, signed in, drives recording on, quiet hours off. A large 'Settings' title (28 sp, bold) sits at the top and shrinks into a slim bar as you scroll. Below it five sections fade and slide up one after another, 40 ms apart, as the screen opens. Each section is a 12 sp uppercase kicker (DRIVES, FRIENDS, SAFETY, ACCOUNT, ABOUT) over a single rounded tonal panel (radius 20, no border, 20 px side gutters, 32 px between sections). Rows inside a panel are 56 to 72 px tall: a 24 px muted icon, a 16 sp semibold title, a 13 sp one-line caption, and a chevron or a switch at the right. DRIVES: 'Units' with a full-width Auto / mph / km/h segmented control beneath it; 'Record drives automatically' with a switch on and the caption 'The app notices when you set off and scores when you park.'; 'Spoken cues' ('On. Short words through the car speakers.'); 'Speed-limit packs' ('Roads and limits kept on this phone.'). FRIENDS: 'Hide my location' switch ('Friends see that you are hiding, not where you are.'); 'Notifications' ('Which alerts reach you.'); 'Quiet hours' ('Off. Set a window when nothing buzzes.'). SAFETY: 'Crash detection' ('On. Checks on you after a hard stop.'); 'Emergency contacts' ('One person gets a text if you do not answer.'); 'Auto-reply to texts' ('Your phone can answer texts while you drive.'). ACCOUNT: a 32 px avatar with your initials and a primary-colour ring, '@handle' as the title and your name as the caption; 'Export my data' ('Every trip on this phone, in a file you keep.'); 'Sign out' ('Trips stay on this phone.'); 'Delete account' in red ('Leaves every league, circle and feed for good. Trips on this phone stay.'). ABOUT: 'About Drivalry' ('Where the roads, maps and weather come from.'); 'Open source' with a small 'MIT' pill ('Read the code, report a bug, build your own.'); 'Diagnostics' ('Numbers for bug reports.'). Every row ripples and gives a light haptic on tap; each switch gives a selection tick as it flips; turning 'Record drives automatically' off slides up a floating snackbar 'Drives are no longer recorded.' with an Undo action. No dividers, no card-in-card, no build or provider names; one continuous scroll with 48 px of air at the bottom.

League detail screen, dark. App bar with no title; invite, members and overflow icons on the right, each with a tooltip. The content fades and slides up on arrival. Headline 28 sp 'Carpool Crew'; under it a 13 sp caption 'Closes Sunday night · 6 days left'. Two hero numbers side by side with 12 sp uppercase kickers 'YOUR RANK' and 'YOUR XP': '#2' and '386' in 40 sp tabular display type that count up from zero when the screen opens, 'XP' as a 14 sp unit beside the figure, captions 'of 6' and '4 trips'. A borderless tonal tile (radius 20, 20 padding) for the group challenge: flag icon, 'Clean trips · 25 trips' in 16 sp, a 6 px thin bar that grows from empty to 68% over 280 ms, captions '17 of 25 trips' and 'Ends Sun, Nov 15 · 12 days left'; the tile scales to 0.97 on press with a light haptic. Two filter chips 'This week' / 'Week of Oct 26'. Caption 'Nov 2 to Nov 8 · ends Sunday at midnight'. A green 12 sp uppercase kicker 'PROMOTION ZONE' with a small up arrow, no box. Standings rows sit flat on the page, 12 apart, and arrive staggered 40 ms apart: 20 sp rank numeral (slides up when it changes), 40 px initials avatar, '@priya' 16 sp, '5 trips' 13 sp caption, '412 XP' in 14 sp tabular that counts up, a compact gold-tinted 'Gold' pill, a 20 px green arrow. Your row ('@kai') is tinted primaryContainer at 40% with a primary ring around the avatar; tapping any row ripples and opens the profile. After rank five a red kicker 'RELEGATION ZONE'. Footer caption 'Top five move up on Sunday night, bottom five move down.' Pull to refresh; loading shows shimmering skeleton rows. A promotion found for you opens a full-screen moment 'PROMOTED / Silver → Gold' with a heavy haptic, once.

Badges screen, dark. App bar 'Badges'. Content fades and slides in. A row of three borderless tonal tiles: 20 px icon, 20 sp bold number, 13 sp label: '12 Clean streak', '23 Phone-free', '+5 Streak XP'. A 12 sp uppercase kicker '4 OF 20 BADGES EARNED'. Then tiles 12 apart, arriving staggered 40 ms apart, each: a 48 px round disc tinted in the badge's category colour with the category icon, the name in 20 sp ('Flawless'), the description in 13 sp ('A trip scored 100.'), the date in 13 sp muted under it ('Dec 19, 2026'). A badge earned in the last week springs its disc in with an elastic scale. Locked badges use a grey disc with a lock, muted name, and either a thin 6 px progress bar in the category colour that grows to its value plus '3/5' (streak badges), or a compact 'Locked' pill. Further down a kicker 'DISHONOURABLE' with the caption 'Lost duels and reckless trips. Worn for a week.' and grey tiles. Loading is shimmering skeleton tiles; errors are one plain sentence. A newly earned badge opens a full-screen moment 'BADGE EARNED' with the description as the headline, the badge name as a pill, confetti and a heavy haptic, once per badge.

Active convoy, I am the leader, dark. A full-bleed Google map under a plain app bar titled with the convoy name ('Coast run') with two actions: Invite (person-add icon, tooltip) and a More overflow (Rename, End trip, Recap, Leave convoy). Floating top-left over the map, 12 px under the bar and 20 px from the edge, a pill capsule on surfaceContainerHigh with a soft 24-blur shadow: a breathing primary dot, a live pill 'On the road', and '3 of 6 cars' in 14 px label. Top-right, two round tonal map buttons (Show everyone, Centre on me); cars are initials pins, the leader ringed; the map camera animates to fit. Rising from the bottom, a sheet with a 28 px top radius on surfaceContainerHigh that snaps to peek (22%), half (46%, where it opens) and full (92%). Inside, 20 px gutters: a 32×4 drag handle; a full-width 64 px filled 'Talk' button with a mic icon (press gives a selection haptic and opens the radio already running); 12 px below, two tonal 56 px buttons side by side, 'Regroup here' and 'Set destination'; 24 px; kicker CARS; one row per car, at least 48 px: a 40 px avatar (photo or initials, primary ring on 'You'), the name in 20 px title ('You', 'Sam', 'Priya'), under it a 14 px label line whose numbers count to their value: '62 mph · 1.2 mi back', '58 mph · Leading', 'Stopped', 'No position yet', 'Last seen 4 min ago'; at the right an ETA pill ('14 min', '~22 min') whose minutes count up, replaced by a yellow 'Fallen behind' pill for a lost car. Rows and tiles scale to 0.97 on press with a light haptic; regroup confirms with a success haptic and 'Regroup pin sent.'. In planning the Talk slot shows a 56 px 'Start trip' (leader) or 'Waiting for Sam to start.' (member); ended shows 'See the recap'.

Radio on, dark. App bar 'Radio'. Content in 20 px gutters from 16 px down: a kicker with the convoy name (COAST RUN), then a 64 px display state word in one of three states, 'Quiet' (plain), 'Live' (primary orange) with a 12 px breathing dot beside it, or 'On air' (error red) with the dot; under it a 20 px title line that cross-fades when it changes: '3 cars connected.', 'Priya is talking.', '2 people are talking.', 'Everyone hears you.'. 32 px below, centred, the 200 px round push-to-talk button: primary, turning error red while held, scaling to 1.06 with its glow widening, a selection haptic on press and again on release, an 88 px mic icon; 12 px under it 'Hold to talk' / 'Transmitting' in 20 px title. 32 px; a 64 px tonal 'Mute everyone' tile (28 px speaker icon, title, caption 'Your mic still works', a Switch at the right; tapping anywhere on the tile toggles it, with the press spring). 32 px; kicker CARS; one row per car, at least 48 px: 40 px avatar, name in title ('Sam', 'Priya', 'Jordan'), a breathing primary dot plus 'Talking' under whoever is on air, and at the right a status pill that cross-fades from 'Connecting…' (neutral) to 'Connected' (green) or 'Reconnecting' (yellow), with a 'Retry' text button only once a link has failed; with no peers, 'No one else is on the radio yet.'. Then one caption, 'Works across networks.' (only when the relay is configured), and a 56 px tonal 'Stop radio' button. No byte counts, no 'Relayed', no 'TURN', no 'data on'. Off state: kicker RADIO, headline 'Radio is off.', body 'Hold to talk, car to car. Nothing is recorded.', 56 px 'Start radio'; opened from Talk it starts on its own and shows 'Starting…' over two shimmering skeleton tiles. Microphone denied: 'Allow the microphone.' with 'Try again' or 'Open settings'. All motion switches off under reduce-motion.
